final:
I found 5 real bugs in this PR and wrote a comment for each to `comments.json`. The file is valid JSON, and I didn't modify the repository.

The PR rewrites 115 lines of the form `scale-color($primary, $lightness: X%)` as `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, X%), scale-color($secondary, (100-X)%))`. The first argument is used on light themes and the second on dark themes. I compared every removed line with its replacement. 110 of them are correct: the light-theme value is unchanged and the dark-theme value is 100 minus it. The other 5 change how existing light themes look, even though the PR is only meant to affect dark themes:

- **`desktop/topic-post.scss:291`**: the two values are swapped (30% became 70%/30%). The bold links in `.topic-meta-data h5` get much paler on light themes.
- **`mobile/modal.scss:102`**: the values are swapped the other way (70% became 30%/70%). The `.custom-message-length` hint turns near-black on light themes and bright on dark themes, instead of muted grey.
- **`desktop/user.scss:522`** and **`mobile/user.scss:497`**: 30% became 50%/50%, so `.group-member-info .name` gets lighter on light themes. It should be 30%/70%.
- **`mobile/topic-post.scss:182`**: 20% became 50%/50%, so the `h3` gets lighter on light themes. It should be 20%/80%.

Each comment includes the corrected `dark-light-choose(...)` call.
